title: Soft White & Black Edge
description: Two looks sharing a quiet, monochromatic palette: look one layers a white baby-doll cami over white ruffle shorts with a tan leather tote and cognac knee boots for a soft, dreamy off-duty look; look two pairs a white long-sleeve crew-neck top with black leggings, a black shoulder bag, and a black knee-high boot, wrapped in a cream fringe scarf and gold-framed sunglasses for a polished minimal city look — a street-style editorial reference anchors the white-on-white direction.
occasion: city stroll, casual day out, weekend errands
